name: NA48 detector

placements.note: Start is the first sourced NA48 data-taking year (1997); end is the last sourced NA48/2 data year (2004).

technology.value: Magnetic spectrometer (helium-filled tank with two drift chambers either side of a dipole magnet) plus liquid-krypton electromagnetic calorimeter, used to reconstruct KL/KS -> 2 pion decays
technology.note: The magnetic-spectrometer description (helium tank, two drift chambers, dipole magnet with 0.88 Tm integrated field) came from a WebSearch aggregation rather than a directly re-fetched primary page in this session; recorded with reduced confidence pending re-verification against a directly fetched detector paper.

summary.plain: The NA48 detector combined a magnetic spectrometer and a calorimeter to track and measure kaon decay particles in an underground hall at CERN, confirming that CP violation happens directly in kaon decay.
summary.technical: Magnetic-spectrometer plus liquid-krypton-calorimeter detector in the ECN3 cavern, run 1997-2004 across the main NA48 programme and its NA48/2 continuation.

notes: No detector-paper key specs were independently re-verified via direct fetch in this session; only run-interval facts (from directly fetched primary sources) carry `confidence: verified`.
